Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

// https://www.lintcode.com/problem/longest-common-subsequence/description
//dp
class Solution {
public:
    /**
     * @param A: A string
     * @param B: A string
     * @return: The length of longest common subsequence of A and B
     */
    int longestCommonSubsequence(string &A, string &B) {
        int lena = A.length();
        int lenb = B.length();
        
        std::vector<vector<int>> dp(lena+1,vector<int>(lenb+1,0));
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= lena; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= lenb; j++) {
                if(A[i-1]==B[j-1]) dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + 1;
                else
                    dp[i][j] = max(dp[i-1][j],dp[i][j-1]);
            }
        }
        return dp[lena][lenb];
    }
};
